# Code of conduct

This project is for people who want to study better. Treat everyone here the way you would want a study partner to treat you.

## Expected

- Be kind and patient, especially with beginners.
- Criticize ideas and code, never people.
- Assume good intent and ask before you judge.
- Accept that the maintainer decides what fits the template.

## Not accepted

- Harassment, insults or personal attacks.
- Discrimination of any kind.
- Sharing someone's private information without permission.
- Spam or self-promotion unrelated to the issue.

## Reporting

Report a problem privately to the maintainer through the contact on the maintainer's GitHub profile. Reports are kept confidential.

## Consequences

The maintainer may edit or remove comments, close issues or pull requests, and block people who break these rules.
